Learned by the sixth lead, added to the list below: (s) a cloud machine's clone is SHALLOW and may be hours behind: `git fetch --deepen=400 origin build/stage-1` and `git merge --ff-only origin/build/stage-1` before reading STATUS.md, then `npm ci`; (t) a lane that gives an admin area its first screen takes that area out of THREE pins: `apps/web/src/features/unreleased/unreleased-page.test.ts`, `adminPlaceholders` in `tests/browser/nothing-unfinished-test.mjs`, and a new READ is listed as a read in `apps/web/src/server/activity-messages.test.ts`: say so in the brief (2.56 lost a trip to GitHub); (u) a lane that changes a table many tests read (or adds screens) has its last helper run `npm run test:units` once and the whole browser chain in chunks of six before the last push: both lanes that did passed GitHub at the next try; (v) a twin that fails where the lane passed on the same commit is an unreliable test: push with `--times=3`, wait on the lane and `-again2`, land with `--twin …-again2`, and write the test on the polish list; (w) NEVER let a helper `pkill` by name: the publishing helper killed another lane's browser; briefs say "stop only the server you started, by its own process id"; (x) a wait started before a fix round keeps running and follows the branch's newest commit: check it with `pgrep -f 'wait-for-github.mjs lane/<name>'` after the push instead of starting a second; (y) the first-look page can be published by the lead with ONE call once a helper of the same session has read it (`Artifact` publish, `file_path` `.local/look/index.html`, `url`); a Sonnet helper judged a sideways scroll as "cut off": tell it what the design is; (z) the working directory of the lead's shell follows the last lane it pushed: every command starts with `cd` to an absolute path.

Learned, not yet rules elsewhere: (a) a lane that adds a page, a route, a field, a table or a helper under `tests/browser` enters it where the build pins them BEFORE its first push: the page-step rows in `scripts/check-web-shell.mjs` for every kind of person (`npm run test:web`), the harmful-text browser test (it must open every page route and type into every free-text field), `HELPERS` in `scripts/web-browser-chain.mjs`, and it runs the whole browser chain in its folder in chunks of six files: say so in every builder's brief (2.49 and 2.207 each lost a trip to GitHub);
